create_piqa_dataset: create a PIQA dataset instance that loads the HuggingFace piqa dataset for classification tasks
run_generate_k_shot_data: run the PIQA dataset to generate k-shot training, dev, and test splits with a given seed
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace PIQA dataset split to a list of input-output tuples with cleaned text
load_piqa_dataset: load the HuggingFace piqa dataset using datasets.load_dataset for few-shot learning tasks
review_piqa_classification_labels: review the PIQA classification labels where 0 maps to solution 1 and 1 maps to solution 2
